```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

``` {r}
penguins

penguin_count <- penguins |>
                 count(species, island)
penguin_count      
```

``` {r}
total_penguins <- penguins |> 
                  summarize(total = n())
                  
total_penguins
```

```{r}
mean_bill_length_mm <- penguins |>
    drop_na() |>
  group_by(species, sex) |>
  summarise(average_bill_length = mean(bill_length_mm))

mean_bill_length_mm
```
